body.name: frontier-conditional total degree schedule
body.construction: Conditional on a proof of \(\mathrm{oeq:sharp\mbox{-}frontier}\), compute \(B_2(n)=\max\{\lceil C_2f_2(n)\rceil,D_2(1),\ldots,D_2(n_0-1)\}\), run \(DBI\) once through its complete internal weighted-degree loop at cutoff \(B_2(n)\), disable finite timeouts, and return exact identifying formulas or the complete negative certificate.
